MassDB SQL 2.0.5-rc415 — product version and source mapping

MassDB SQL uses independent product version numbers. Its 2.0.5-rc415 number must
not be used as an Apache Doris version when assigning package identifiers or
matching vulnerabilities.

Version display: the legal page shows MassDB V2.0.5. SQL @@version_comment
returns massdb-2.0.5-sql-rc415 without a Git hash. FE and BE heartbeat versions use
the same value in SHOW FRONTENDS / BACKENDS and SHOW PROC '/frontends' / '/backends'.
The FE home page, BE home page/footer, version HTTP APIs, FE bootstrap response
and FE/BE/Cloud version metric labels also use massdb-2.0.5-sql-rc415. Each node must run
the updated binary and report a heartbeat. @@version and the MySQL handshake
retain 5.7.99 for client compatibility. Internal build identifiers and package
names retain massdb-sql-2.0.5-rc415, with source identity in the build records.

JDBC catalogs recognize both Doris and MassDB version comments and retain Doris
column type mapping for MassDB targets. Older Doris/MassDB clients or third-party
tools that identify servers only by the word "doris" require a corresponding
client-side update; the new product version does not change their detection rules.
JDBC array decoding also preserves exact large integers, including nested arrays,
instead of rounding them through an intermediate floating-point value.
Array reads and JDBC insert-select copies retain NULL elements, nested NULL arrays,
floating-point signed zero and timestamp fractions at precisions 0 through 6.
Parameterized array elements use the precision, scale and length in the Doris type
declaration instead of the outer array column's JDBC metadata.

Upstream source baseline: Apache Doris 4.1.5-release source version on branch-4.1.
Upstream commit: 917b20be83878e98f94e3ebf7efccc80346e3e50
Source: https://github.com/apache/doris/commit/917b20be83878e98f94e3ebf7efccc80346e3e50
This records a source baseline, not a claim that MassDB is an ASF release.
Evaluate vulnerability applicability against actual dependency versions,
upstream code, local changes and backported fixes.

Modifications from the upstream baseline include MassDB branding and web pages,
SQL/search and transaction/report handling changes, selected upstream backports,
and build/deployment adjustments. The FE/UI logos, favicon and login background
have been replaced. The interface adds company attribution, local third-party
notices and transparent copyright footers.

Inherited rc02 UI changes: align the Playground sidebar and editor heights, reserve footer
space within the viewport, and align the search and refresh controls. The sidebar
resizes with the editor and adapts to narrow screens. Simplify the company footer;
the notices page and NOTICE retain the full copyright scope.

File-level modification notices remain in the distributed scripts and source.
References to MODIFICATIONS.md in source headers refer to the detailed history
in the source repository; that development record is not a runtime dependency.

版本说明：MassDB SQL 2.0.5-rc415 是产品独立编号，上游源码基线为 Apache Doris
4.1.5-release。SBOM/CVE 评估须使用实际组件版本和代码差异，不把产品编号作为上游版本。

版本展示：版权声明页显示 MassDB V2.0.5；@@version_comment 返回
massdb-2.0.5-sql-rc415，不追加 Git 哈希。SHOW FRONTENDS / BACKENDS 和
SHOW PROC '/frontends' / '/backends' 的 Version 列使用相同版本；各节点需更新
程序并完成心跳上报。FE 首页、BE 首页与页尾、版本 HTTP 接口、FE 启动状态
接口和版本监控标签也统一为 massdb-2.0.5-sql-rc415。@@version 和 MySQL 握手保持 5.7.99，
用于客户端兼容。内部构建与安装包编号仍为 massdb-sql-2.0.5-rc415，构建记录保留源码信息。

JDBC catalog 同时识别 Doris 和 MassDB 版本声明，连接 MassDB 时保留 Doris 列类型映射。
旧版 Doris/MassDB 客户端或仅凭 "doris" 识别数据库的第三方工具，需同步更新其识别逻辑。
同时修复 JDBC 数组解码经浮点数中转导致的大整数精度丢失，涵盖嵌套数组。
数组读取及 JDBC 查询后写入保留 NULL 元素、嵌套 NULL 数组、浮点负零和 0–6 位时间精度。
数组元素的小数精度、标度及字符串长度从 Doris 完整类型声明读取，避免误用外层列元数据。

修改说明：包含 MassDB 品牌与页面、SQL/搜索及事务/报告处理调整、上游补丁回移，
以及构建部署修改。FE/UI 的 Logo、favicon 和登录背景已替换，增加公司署名、
本地开源声明和透明页脚。详细开发记录保留在源码仓库的 MODIFICATIONS.md。

继承 rc02 的界面更新：Playground 左右面板等高，页脚在视口内统一预留空间；搜索框与刷新
按钮对齐，侧栏拖动时编辑器随之调整，并适配窄屏显示。简化公司页脚文案，
完整版权范围说明保留于声明页和 NOTICE。

Changes in rc415: move the source baseline to Apache Doris 4.1.5-release.
Preserve MassDB branding, JDBC array fidelity, report queue deduplication and
parallel consumption, storage-medium caching, compaction safeguards, Group Commit
timeouts and metadata-tool initialization. Keep upstream fixes for Group Commit
backend routing, aborted-load locking and CLucene multi-segment readers. The
report-diff executor safeguard now lives in LocalTabletInvertedIndex.

Regression hardening: interrupted report enqueue no longer strands a pending
deduplication key. Storage-medium cache entries are invalidated by metadata
changes and SSD cooldown deadlines. Ordered-compaction fallback replaces its
input counters instead of adding them twice. The standalone metadata tool
initializes schema and column caches, and stack symbol lookup recognizes the
split debug files installed with Release binaries.
The slim release package keeps debug symbols in its separate audit archive.
Deploy the matching lib/debug_info/<binary>.dbg file when full stack symbol
names are needed; the slim package alone may show unresolved addresses.
In same-host validation, deploying these symbols added approximately 300-400 MiB
of RSS per BE. RSS includes shareable file mappings. Slim deployment without the
separate symbols did not exhibit this fixed increase.

Code review fixes: rebuilding the storage-medium map no longer waits for a table
whose lock is held. The table is skipped, the incomplete map is reused for at most
storage_medium_map_retry_second (default 5) and then rebuilt, and an expired SSD
partition whose table cannot be locked no longer forces a rebuild on every report.
Tablet reports no longer abort when a replica of a cooling-down tablet is deleted
concurrently. JDBC catalogs accept Doris DECIMAL(p) and type declarations followed
by attributes. Reloading a Playground page for a database or table named like a
page, such as home or Session, loads the UI again. A prepared Group Commit insert
waits for its BE at most the internal Group Commit load timeout plus
group_commit_insert_rpc_timeout_second (default 300) instead of the whole insert
timeout. The BE request is not cancelled, so rows of a timed-out insert may still be
written; do not retry such an insert blindly.

rc415 更新：源码基线升级至 Apache Doris 4.1.5-release；保留 MassDB 品牌、
JDBC 数组精度、报告去重与并行处理、存储介质缓存、compaction 防护、
Group Commit 超时与元数据工具初始化修复。已有上游修复使用 4.1.5 的实现。
修复报告入队被中断后去重键滞留、存储介质缓存未随元数据变更或 SSD 冷却到期失效、
有序 compaction 回退时输入计数重复累加等问题。补齐独立元数据工具所需的 schema/column
缓存初始化；调用栈符号查找支持 Release 构建安装的分离调试文件。
精简包仍将调试符号保存在独立审计归档中；需要完整调用栈名称时，应部署与程序匹配的
lib/debug_info/<binary>.dbg。只部署精简包时，部分地址仍可能无法解析为函数名。
本次同机验证中，部署完整符号使每个 BE 的 RSS 增加约 300-400 MiB（含可共享文件映射）；
不部署分离符号的精简配置未出现这部分固定增量。
代码审查修复：重建存储介质映射时不再等待被长时间加锁的表，该表本轮跳过，不完整的映射
最多复用 storage_medium_map_retry_second（默认 5 秒）后重建；已到期 SSD 分区拿不到写锁时
不再导致每次上报都重建。冷却中 tablet 的副本被并发删除时，tablet 上报不再中断。
JDBC catalog 支持 Doris 的 DECIMAL(p) 以及后接属性的类型声明。库名或表名与页面同名
（如 home、Session）时，刷新 Playground 页面可正常加载。预编译 Group Commit 插入等待
BE 的时间不超过内部攒批导入超时加 group_commit_insert_rpc_timeout_second（默认 300 秒），
不再等满整个导入超时；BE 端请求不会被取消，超时报错的插入仍可能写入，不应直接重试。
历史二进制审查记录仅适用于原审查包，不代表 rc415 已完成构建或验证。
